caption: Paired comparison on the common test windows (both instruments observing; 104,186 labelled windows on 162 days for the in-progress head). Each point is E4 minus a single-instrument experiment on the same windows, each model at its own validation threshold and calibration; bars are 95% intervals from resampling the same whole test days for both models. Filled vermillion squares: E4 - E1 (the value of adding HEL1OS); open blue triangles: E4 - E2 (the value of adding SoLEXS). Left: flare heads (>= C1); right: flux error by horizon, one panel per comparison on its own scale.
